study_form.studyName: Global Atlas of Dominant Soil Bacteria
study_form.description: Soil samples collected from globally distributed sites across six continents to survey the dominant bacterial taxa in soil ecosystems. This study investigates which bacterial lineages consistently dominate soil communities worldwide and identifies ecological groupings with shared habitat preferences.
study_form.notes: Reference publication is all-rights-reserved (Science, AAAS). No open-access license; abstract accessible via CrossRef but content cannot be used as AI context.
